# OficinaOS

> Free, MIT-licensed, self-hosted management system for phone repair shops.
> Runs on a PC inside the shop over the LAN — customer data never leaves by
> default. Optional paid "Pro" modules (gated server-side via OficinaOS Cloud,
> no license files) add a public customer portal, a WhatsApp bot, remote
> diagnostics intake and AI reports. Documentation in Portuguese (default),
> English and Spanish.

## Documentation

- [Full guide (PT)](https://oficinaos.app/docs/): install (Docker/portable), daily use, backups, remote access, Pro modules, pricing, FAQ
- [Full guide (EN)](https://oficinaos.app/en/docs/): same guide in English
- [Full guide (ES)](https://oficinaos.app/es/docs/): same guide in Spanish

## Pro module guides

- [Customer portal (PT)](https://oficinaos.app/docs/portal/): public per-repair link, quote accept/decline, privacy model
- [Customer portal (EN)](https://oficinaos.app/en/docs/portal/)
- [Customer portal (ES)](https://oficinaos.app/es/docs/portal/)
- [WhatsApp bot (PT)](https://oficinaos.app/docs/whatsapp/): commands, Meta requirements, setup, limits
- [WhatsApp bot (EN)](https://oficinaos.app/en/docs/whatsapp/)
- [WhatsApp bot (ES)](https://oficinaos.app/es/docs/whatsapp/)
- [SMS channel (PT)](https://oficinaos.app/docs/sms/): SMS via a local Android gateway (sms-gate) — setup, bot commands, limits
- [SMS channel (EN)](https://oficinaos.app/en/docs/sms/)
- [SMS channel (ES)](https://oficinaos.app/es/docs/sms/)
- [OficinaOS Diag (PT)](https://oficinaos.app/docs/diag/): free Windows USB diagnostic tool — features, requirements, troubleshooting
- [OficinaOS Diag (EN)](https://oficinaos.app/en/docs/diag/)
- [OficinaOS Diag (ES)](https://oficinaos.app/es/docs/diag/)

## Customer-facing agent interfaces

- [Customer portal JSON](https://cloud.oficinaos.app/api/portal/): per-repair JSON at `/api/portal/<token>` — the 16-hex token in the tracking URL is the credential; quote replies via POST `…/reply` `{kind:"quote",decision:"approve"|"reject",quoteId}`

## Repositories

- [OficinaOS app](https://github.com/braindeadpt/OficinaOS): the shop app (MIT)
- [oficinaos-cloud](https://github.com/braindeadpt/oficinaos-cloud): pairing, entitlements, webhook/queue relays
- [oficinaos-diag](https://github.com/braindeadpt/oficinaos-diag): Windows diagnostic tool (MIT)
- [oficinaos-website](https://github.com/braindeadpt/oficinaos-website): this site
- [Ecosystem map](https://github.com/braindeadpt/OficinaOS/blob/main/docs/ecosystem.md): how the 4 repos interconnect

## Optional
